page.notes: The right-hand strip of text (olen, ecus, molef and similar fragments) belongs to the facing page and is left out. Doubtful readings: the marked word after "non" in the psalm reference is printed "1?9" (Psalm 119 or 109); the name after "sanctus" is printed as an abbreviation with a split "Dauid" (rendered D[?]); the ligature in "Edostus" is copied as printed.
